meaning:
1) adornment, glory
1a) holy adornment (of public worship)
1b) glory (of the king)

elsewhere.note: Ascribe to Yahweh the glory due to his name. Bring an offering, and come before him. Worship Yahweh in holy array.
When he had taken counsel with the people, he appointed those who were to sing to Yahweh, and give praise in holy array, as they go out before the army, and…
Ascribe to Yahweh the glory due to his name. Worship Yahweh in holy array.
In the multitude of people is the king’s glory, but in the lack of people is the destruction of the prince.
